observations: Photos 0 and 1: a black Nikon DSLR body with the body cap on, standing on its retail box, beside a kit zoom lens with front cap on.
Lens barrel reads 'Nikon DX' and 'VR' with focal marks 24, 35, 45, 55 visible, consistent with an 18-55mm kit zoom.
Box reads 'Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit, AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II, BLACK' (photos 0 and 1).
Exterior of body and lens looks clean in these photos; no scratches visible at this resolution.
Camera is not shown powered on; no screen, shutter count, battery, charger, strap or receipt shown.
Shop shelf background with flash and selfie stick boxes; watermark 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', so a dealer listing.
Photos 0 and 1 are near duplicates from slightly different angles.

identity.model: D3300 with AF-S DX 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II kit lens

claims.claim: 24.2 MP CMOS DX-format sensor, 5 fps continuous shooting, 11 AF points with 3D tracking
claims.evidence: These are the published specs of the Nikon D3300, which is read off the body in photos 0 and 1; the specs follow from the model, not from a test.
Exterior looks clean in photos 0 and 1, but no close-ups of the screen, mount, sensor or lens glass, and no shutter count.
Internal repair history cannot be seen in photos.
Camera is not shown powered on or taking a picture.
No receipt or warranty card shown; a warranty on a D3300 kit is unlikely to still be valid given the model's age.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, shutter or autofocus may fail, or the screen may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, taking a shot with the lens autofocusing, and playing the image back on the rear screen.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy prior use despite a clean exterior.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count read from the EXIF of a fresh photo taken today.

risks.risk: Lens fungus, haze, scratches, or a faulty VR or autofocus motor.
risks.proof: Close-up of the front and rear lens glass lit by a torch, plus the same autofocus video.
Photo of the battery and original charger beside the camera.

risks.risk: Body serial may not match the box or receipt; stolen or swapped unit.
risks.proof: Close-up of the serial sticker under the body next to the box serial label.
risks.if_unproven: as unmatched box, body priced alone

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, autofocusing, taking a shot and showing it on the screen
Screenshot of the shutter count from a photo taken today
Close-up of the body serial sticker next to the box serial label
Close-ups of the lens glass front and rear with a torch

response.reason: The Nikon D3300 body and 18-55 VR kit lens are read off the body, lens and box in photos 0 and 1, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working until a powered video and shutter count are sent.
